生成查询代码
SELECT
    FUND_NAME AS `基金名称`,
    FUND_SYMBOL AS `基金代码`,
    YEAR AS `年份`,
    ROUND(YIELD, 2) AS `年度收益率(%)`,
    MAX_DRAWBACK AS `最大回撤`,
    ROUND(SHARPE, 2) AS `夏普比率`,
    NAV_BEGIN AS `净值开始日期`,
    NAV_END AS `净值结束日期`
FROM
    FUND_STATISTICS_YEAR
WHERE
    FUND_NAME LIKE '%中欧医疗健康混合A%'
    AND YEAR = 2025
    AND YIELD IS NOT NULL
    AND HISVALID = 1
ORDER BY
    YEAR DESC
LIMIT 10
